latestStrategyReport.executiveSummary: Platform performance is currently hindered by a high cancellation rate, likely due to friction in the booking flow for heavy-duty services. While AI commission protections are effectively securing revenue, immediate intervention is required to address provider wallet thresholds and improve cancellation transparency.
bugAndFrictionFindings: High cancellation rate in 'Furniture & Heavy Item Loading' suggests a lack of clear pricing or logistical scope definition for users.
The 'Skipped reason' trend in cancellations indicates a UI/UX failure in the feedback loop, preventing actionable data collection.
Duplicate provider entries for 'tinashe' suggest a database indexing issue or inconsistent user profile management.
businessStrategies: Implement an automated SMS/WhatsApp reminder system for providers below the $2 minimum wallet balance to prevent service downtime.
Introduce a mandatory 'Cancellation Reason' selection modal to replace the current 'Skipped' option to improve service quality analytics.
Launch a 'Findit Harare Pro' loyalty program for high-rated providers like Tariro Ncube to incentivize retention and platform exclusivity.
Adjust the commission structure for high-cancellation categories to include a small 'booking commitment fee' to discourage non-serious requests.
